clauses.standard_text: Either party may terminate this lease with 30 days' written notice after the initial term.
Rent paid more than 5 days late incurs a late fee of $50 or 5% of monthly rent, whichever is less.
Landlord shall provide at least 24 hours' written notice before entering the premises, except in emergencies.
Early termination by Tenant requires payment of one (1) month's rent as liquidated damages.
Security deposit shall be returned within 30 days of move-out, less itemized deductions for damages beyond normal wear and tear.
